origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 去 (to go) as the sound: a heart that wants to run away, timid.

讳.def: taboo; to shun, to conceal, to avoid mentioning

origin.says: Simplified from 諱: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 韦 (leather) as the sound: words one must avoid, a taboo.

讳.name: taboo

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 出 (go out) as the sound: unskilled with the hands, clumsy.

ety.hint: A hand 巾 holding a broom with the head 彐 held up

origin.says: A picture of a broom: bristles on top and a tied handle below. In the modern form the top looks like 彐 (hand sign) and the bottom like 冖 (cover) over 巾 (cloth).
冫 (ice) for the meaning plus 妻 (wife) as the sound: bitter cold, dreary, sad. It replaces the older 淒, whose 氵 (water) became 冫.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 因 (cause) as the sound: the throat, and to swallow (for which it also stands in for 嚥).
石 (stone) for the meaning plus 肖 as the sound: saltpeter, a mineral; also to tan leather.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 华 (splendid) as the sound: a loud noise of voices, uproar. Simplified from 嘩, with 華 replaced by 华.

胧.def: blurry, obscured; the condition or appearance of the moon

origin.says: 月 (moon, not flesh here) for the meaning plus 龙 (dragon) as the sound: the dim, hazy look of the moon. Simplified from 朧, with 龍 written 龙.

胧.name: hazy moon

惦.def: to think of, to remember, to miss

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 店 (shop) as the sound: to keep someone in mind, to miss them.

惦.name: miss

origin.says: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 京 (capital) as the sound: to dry something in the sun or air.

ety.hint: A wooden 木 cabinet 厨; 厨 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 厨 (kitchen) as the sound: a wooden cabinet, cupboard. Simplified from 櫥, with 厨 for 廚.

朦.def: dim, obscure; the condition of the moon

origin.says: 月 (moon) for the meaning plus 蒙 (cover) as the sound: a moon veiled and dim, hence hazy, blurry. Here 月 really is the moon, not flesh.

朦.name: dim moonlight

origin.says: From 辮: 糸 (silk) for the meaning between two 辛 (bitter), which together give the sound: strands twisted together, a braid. The simplified form uses 纟 (silk).

幺.in: 率幼幻滋慈摔幽畜蓄弦溪磁炫蟀吆玄拗兹

诙.def: to tease, to joke with; to ridicule, to mock

ety.hint: A person, crouched 尸 passing water 水

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms draw a man passing water. Seal script wrote 尾 (tail, the rear) plus 水 (water); 尾 was later cut to 尸: urine.
忄 (heart, mind) for the meaning plus 光 (light) as the sound: a dazzled, absent mind. It took over the use of an older character.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 爵 (noble rank) as the sound: to chew.

怂.def: to arouse, to incite, to instigate

恿.def: to instigate, to incite, to alarm

揣.def: to stow in one's clothes; to estimate, to guess, to figure

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 耑 (sprout, tip) as the sound: to weigh in the hand, to estimate; also to tuck into one's clothes.

揣.name: tuck away

贮.def: to store, to stockpile, to hoard

ety.hint: Money 贝 kept under one 一 roof 宀

origin.says: Simplified from 貯: 貝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 宁 (a storage chest) as the sound: to store valuables. 貝 is written 贝 and 宁 as 㝉.

贮.name: stockpile

origin.says: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 巴 as the sound: a mark left by a wound or sore, a scar.
月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 贰 (two) as the sound: rich, greasy meat; then fed up with too much of it. Simplified from 膩.

斡.def: to turn, to rotate, to revolve

璨.def: gem; the luster of a gem

ety.hint: The luster 粲 of a gem 王; 粲 also provides the pronunciation
A spoon 勹 with something in it 丶

origin.says: A drawing of a ladle (勹) with something in it (丶 dot): 'ladle, spoon'. One reading calls the dot a mark for the contents.
扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 敝 (tattered) as the sound: to cast aside; also the left-falling brush stroke.

遂.def: to fail; to follow, to comply with

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 㒸 (an old character) as the sound: to go along with, to follow through, to succeed. The pig in 㒸 only gives sound.

遂.name: follow through

斟.def: to deliberate, to gauge; to pour wine or tea

origin.says: 甚 (very) as the sound plus 斗 (dipper) for the meaning: to ladle or pour wine; weighing how much to pour gave 'to deliberate'.

斟.name: pour wine

酌.def: to pour wine, to drink wine; to deliberate, to consider

origin.says: 酉 (wine jar) for the meaning plus 勺 (ladle) as the sound, and its sense too: ladling out wine, 'to pour wine'; weighing one's drink became 'to consider'.

酌.name: deliberate

origin.says: 虫 (bug) for the meaning plus 斗 (dipper) as the sound, a tadpole being dipper-shaped: tadpole.
石 (stone) for the meaning plus a shortened 流 (flow) as the sound: the mineral sulfur.

漓.def: dripping water; a river in Guangxi province

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 离 (leave) as the sound: water dripping and soaking; also the Li river in Guangxi. Replaces 灕.

漓.name: dripping

熔.def: mold; to fuse, to melt, to smelt

ety.hint: To form 容 hot metal 火; 容 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 容 (contain) as the sound: to melt metal by fire, to smelt.

熔.name: fuse metal

origin.says: 虫 (creature) for the meaning plus 科 (category) as the sound: the tadpole.

ety.hint: A yellow 黄 mineral 石; 黄 also provides the pronunciation

惹.def: to incite, to irritate, to offend, to vex

origin.says: 若 (as if) as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning: to stir up feelings, to provoke.

惹.name: irritate

origin.says: 箕 (winnowing basket, itself 𥫗 bamboo over 其) for the meaning plus 皮 (skin) as the sound: to toss grain in the basket, winnow. The 皮 sits inside the basket, under its bamboo top.

睬.def: to notice, to pay attention to

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 采 (pluck) as the sound: to look at, to pay attention to.

睬.name: notice

妖.def: strange, weird, supernatural; bewitching, enchanting, seductive

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 夭 (young, bending) as the sound: first a bewitching beauty, then anything uncanny, a demon or monster.

妖.name: bewitching

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 肖 as the sound: steep, precipitous. An older form had 阝 (hill) in place of 山.
歹 (bare bones, death) for the meaning plus 央 (center) as the sound: a disaster or calamity.

ety.hint: A hall 堂 in one's chest ⺼; 堂 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: A post-classical character: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 堂 (hall) as the sound: the chest cavity, a hollow inside.
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 奥 (deep inner corner) as the sound: vexed, regretful.
口 (mouth, here a beak) for the meaning plus 豖 (a hobbled pig) as the sound: to peck.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 弟 (younger brother) as the sound: tears, and nasal mucus.
艹 (plants) for the meaning plus 委 (bent, yielding) as the sound: plants drooping, to wither.

唾.def: to spit; to spit on; saliva

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 垂 (droop) as the sound: saliva, to spit.

唾.name: saliva

ety.hint: A silk cocoon 艹 spun by a worm 虫

origin.says: Simplified from 繭: 糸 (silk) with 虫 (insect) under a needlework top, a silkworm's cocoon. The simplified form keeps the top as 艹 (grass) and 虫, dropping the silk.
From 餒: 饣 (food) for the meaning plus 妥 (settled) as the sound: lacking food, starving, and so losing heart. 食 became 饣.

颐.def: cheeks, jaw; chin; rear; to nourish

涮.def: to rinse; to boil or cook in juice

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 刷 (brush) as the sound: to rinse, and to dip thin slices into boiling broth.

涮.name: hotpot dip

ety.hint: A bed of wood 木 and feathers 羽 to sleep in at night 日

荤.def: non-vegetarian food; garlic; a foul smell

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 军 (army) as the sound: first strong-smelling plants like garlic and onion, then meat dishes. Simplified from 葷 (軍 to 军).

荤.name: garlic smell

origin.says: 虫 (insect) for the meaning plus 悉 (to know fully) as the sound: used in the word for cricket.
虫 (insect) for the meaning plus 率 (lead) as the sound: used in 蟋蟀 (cricket).
𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 干 (shield) as the sound: a bamboo pole.
土 (earth) for the meaning plus 后 (behind; queen) as the sound: earth stuck on you, dirt and filth.
女 (woman) for the meaning plus 兆 (omen) as the sound: graceful, attractive; mostly a surname now.

ety.hint: A tall building 享 at the edge of a city 阝

origin.says: Old forms show watchtowers on a city wall; this became 享 (enjoy), unrelated, and 阝 (city) was added: the outer city wall.

溺.def: to spoil, to pamper, to indulge; to drown

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 弱 (weak) as the sound: to sink and drown in water, then to drown in indulgence.

溺.name: overindulge

origin.says: Simplified from 嬌: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 乔 (tall) as the sound: lovely, delicate; pampered.
